title: Photo Recovery: Video & File
summary: Restore deleted photos & videos with smart deep scan. File recovery made easy.
description:
Accidentally deleted important files? Lost precious photos or videos?

Photo Recovery: Video & File is a powerful photo recovery app designed to help you recover deleted photos and videos from your device using a smart deep scan. It also supports file recovery for common audio and document formats, allowing you to restore what matters most with ease.

🔍 What You Can Recover

📸 Photo Recovery
Recover deleted photos from your device storage.
Supported image formats include JPG, JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP, GIF.

🎬 Video Recovery
Scan your phone to find and restore deleted videos safely.
Common video formats supported: MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV.

🎵 Audio Recovery
Recover deleted audio files such as recordings and music.
Supported formats include MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A.

📄 Document Recovery
Restore lost documents found during scanning.
Common formats include PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT.

📂 File Recovery
A unified recovery solution for photos, videos, audio, and documents.

⚡ Key Features
- Smart deep scan to find deleted files
- Preview photos, videos, and documents before recovery
- Simple and intuitive interface
- No root required
- Works fully offline
Whether you need photo recovery, video recovery, or a reliable file recovery app, this tool helps you recover deleted files in just a few simple steps.

🔐 Privacy & Security
Your privacy is important to us.
All scanning and recovery processes are performed locally on your device.
We do not collect, store, or upload any personal data.

⚠️ Important Notes
This app attempts to scan and recover photos, videos, audio, documents, and other files found in specific storage paths (such as /./) on your device, including cached files deleted by other apps.
Recovery results may vary depending on device model, storage condition, and file system status. Not all deleted files can be recovered.
Files deleted before a factory reset cannot be recovered.

🚀 Get Started
Download Photo Recovery: Video & File now and recover your deleted photos and videos with confidence.
